title: Inventory reusable formal and supervisor primitives

swissknife.inventory_note: SwissKnife presentation surfaces are out of FACP-001 primary reuse scope; authority remains host-side.

Mcp-Plus-Plus.inventory_note: MCP++ will own normative FCA; this inventory records existing supervisor/kit/datasets primitives to adapt.

policy.total_assurance_ladder_rule: Every total assurance ladder is flagged for conservative Formal Claim Algebra adaptation rather than duplication; legacy ranks may inform at most one FCA dimension and must not acquire evidence dimensions they did not carry.

components.semantic_authority: Authoritative ordered proof-assurance lattice for policy and completion gates inside the supervisor proof stack; projects from typed evidence and must not be treated as a free-standing claimed field.
gaps: Collapses multidimensional FCA evidence (origin/integrity/authority/policy/proof/freshness/effect/environment/review) into one rank.
Compatibility aliases (NONE/SOLVER_VERIFIED) can mask semantic drift.
Does not encode hermetic-vs-live environment or freshness.

compatibility_risk.rationale: Widely imported by planners, caches, and completion gates; incorrect remapping would broaden promotions.

fca_adaptation.rationale: Flagged for conservative FCA adaptation rather than duplication: rank values may inform the proof dimension only and must not invent missing EvidenceEnvelope dimensions.

components.semantic_authority: Local ordered assurance vocabulary for database-repair evidence records; authoritative only within that evidence store, not portfolio promotion.
gaps: Diverges from formal_verification_contracts.AssuranceLevel (adds HEURISTIC/VALIDATED; different NONE semantics).
Second total ladder risks dual authorities if either is duplicated into FCA.

compatibility_risk.rationale: Incompatible twin ladder; duplication would create conflicting promotion semantics.

fca_adaptation.rationale: Flagged for conservative FCA adaptation rather than duplication: reconcile through a compatibility adapter into FCA; do not promote either ladder as normative.

components.semantic_authority: Closed proof/refutation status for program-logic predictions, independent of source authority and scores.
gaps: Mixes status, freshness (STALE), and error into one enum.
CANDIDATE/SOLVER_CHECKED/KERNEL_VERIFIED ranks parallel AssuranceLevel without shared identity.

compatibility_risk.rationale: Cross-module comparisons already treat ProofStatus like an assurance rank.

fca_adaptation.rationale: Flagged for conservative FCA adaptation rather than duplication: map status into proof/freshness facets separately.

components.semantic_authority: Property-specific non-ordered evidence classes for formal-planning adversarial admission; policy must name acceptable classes rather than ranking strings.
gaps: Still coexists with AssuranceLevel ranks in the same module.
Does not cover origin/environment product dimensions required by FCA.

compatibility_risk.rationale: Explicitly non-ordered; closer to FCA product thinking than total ladders.

fca_adaptation.rationale: Reuse as a non-ordered class vocabulary; do not collapse into AssuranceLevel ranks.

components.semantic_authority: Closed non-interchangeable activation artifact roles (candidate vs current vs certificate); authoritative that roles cannot be relabeled into each other.
gaps: Scoped to proof-backed test reuse activation, not general production claims.
AUTHORITATIVE_CERTIFICATE still depends on local re-verify before SKIP.

compatibility_risk.rationale: Role distinctions are reference semantics for candidate/current separation in FCA.

fca_adaptation.rationale: Adapt candidate/current/certificate role separation into FCA proof/freshness facets; do not invent a second role lattice.

components.semantic_authority: Inventory-assigned backend support tier; never inferred at runtime and not live qualification evidence by itself.
gaps: PRODUCTION/CONDITIONAL tiers are not hermetic/conditional/live observation environments.
Configuration-only backends can still appear supported if misread as live-qualified.

compatibility_risk.rationale: Support-tier wording is easy to confuse with live capability receipts.

fca_adaptation.rationale: Flagged for conservative FCA adaptation rather than duplication: map tiers into environment/support claims without promoting configuration inventory to live observation.

components.semantic_authority: Closed kinds of effect/durability evidence references (WAL, CID, replica receipt); never raw bodies and never logical proof validity.
gaps: Storage-effect evidence only; does not authorize logical proof or admission.
Integrity_PROOF kind name can be misread as semantic proof.

compatibility_risk.rationale: Effect-evidence vocabulary is compatible with Kit ownership in the FACP plan.

fca_adaptation.rationale: Not a total assurance ladder; reuse or adapt under stated disposition.

components.semantic_authority: Authoritative content-addressed proof-certificate blob store with digest checks; not logical proof validity or authorization.
gaps: Stores bytes/CIDs only; verifier acceptance lives elsewhere.
Remote get adapters must remain integrity-checked.

compatibility_risk.rationale: CAS semantics are load-bearing for certificate persistence.

fca_adaptation.rationale: Not a total assurance ladder; reuse or adapt under stated disposition.

components.semantic_authority: Stable semantic evidence categories for IR; none implies proof authority by itself.
gaps: Parallel vocabulary to accelerate/kit EvidenceKind enums without shared identity.
Does not encode promotion predicates.

compatibility_risk.rationale: Cross-repository EvidenceKind collision risk during FCA binding generation.

fca_adaptation.rationale: Adapt into FCA/CCC shared vocabulary; do not keep three normative EvidenceKind authorities.

components.semantic_authority: Review lifecycle for addressed evidence (unreviewed through quarantined); closest existing match to FCA review dimension.
gaps: Includes ACCEPTED/REJECTED which can be mistaken for production success.
Not bound to authority/freshness/effect dimensions.

compatibility_risk.rationale: Review status may be over-read as admission.

fca_adaptation.rationale: Not a total assurance ladder; reuse or adapt under stated disposition.

components.semantic_authority: Authoritative typed proof-verdict and receipt contract vocabulary for the supervisor proof stack; conclusive only for PROVED/DISPROVED.
gaps: Coupled to AssuranceLevel total ladder in the same module.
Provider-claimed assurance fields require independent kernel evidence.

compatibility_risk.rationale: Schema@version bindings are widely consumed by caches and planners.

fca_adaptation.rationale: Not a total assurance ladder; reuse or adapt under stated disposition.

components.semantic_authority: Durable reconstructable proof-cache store under binding checks; cache hits are not a trust root and must re-derive authority.
gaps: DuckDB/single-flight coupling.
Draft/attestation namespaces must remain non-authoritative.

compatibility_risk.rationale: Process-safe cache key schemas are deep dependencies for proof reuse.

fca_adaptation.rationale: Not a total assurance ladder; reuse or adapt under stated disposition.

components.semantic_authority: Federation/admission gate over FormalVerificationCache for doctor lanes; not a second proof trust root.
gaps: Multiple nominating surfaces increase mis-binding risk.
Must not bypass FormalVerificationCache reconstruct-on-hit rules.

compatibility_risk.rationale: Doctor-lane specific but reuses core cache contracts.

fca_adaptation.rationale: Not a total assurance ladder; reuse or adapt under stated disposition.

components.semantic_authority: Adapter for proof-backed test-reuse admission after local re-verify; serialized trusted flags are never authority alone.
gaps: Depends on external certificate providers and current locator freshness.

compatibility_risk.rationale: Reuse decisions couple to test certificate schemas.

fca_adaptation.rationale: Not a total assurance ladder; reuse or adapt under stated disposition.

components.semantic_authority: Supervisor boundary from pytest proof-cache SKIP to completion evidence; historical certificates alone do not validate.
gaps: Short-lived receipts; requires live tree + certificate re-verify.

compatibility_risk.rationale: Ties validation completion gates to the test-reuse stack.

fca_adaptation.rationale: Not a total assurance ladder; reuse or adapt under stated disposition.

components.semantic_authority: Coordinator for restartable proof-carrying workflow state and decisions; must not promote provider status strings across evidence roles.
gaps: Integration adapters (provider/prover/merge/monitor) must be explicit.
Consumes AssuranceLevel total ladder for plan assurance thresholds.

compatibility_risk.rationale: Duplicating this orchestration would fork trust boundaries.

fca_adaptation.rationale: Not a total assurance ladder; reuse or adapt under stated disposition.

components.semantic_authority: Multi-gate plan admission join that strips provider admitted/valid/passed claims and binds receipts to tree/IR/proof roots.
gaps: Hard-stage ordering must remain fail-closed under FCA.
Unknown mandatory applicability must not soft-succeed.

compatibility_risk.rationale: Central admission choke point for the future control plane.

fca_adaptation.rationale: Not a total assurance ladder; reuse or adapt under stated disposition.

components.semantic_authority: Compiles plan sources into FormalWorkPlan/admission artifacts; compilation success is not proof or execution permit.
gaps: Multiple source surfaces need stable identity bindings.

compatibility_risk.rationale: Large surface coupled to planning vocabulary and admission IR.

fca_adaptation.rationale: Not a total assurance ladder; reuse or adapt under stated disposition.

components.semantic_authority: Consistency validator for FormalWorkPlan over a reviewed DCEC/TDFOL subset; not code-correctness or work-happened attestation.
gaps: Positive plan check is not kernel_verified without reconstructing kernel evidence.

compatibility_risk.rationale: Deliberately small reference model.

fca_adaptation.rationale: Not a total assurance ladder; reuse or adapt under stated disposition.

components.semantic_authority: Canonical contract shape for formal work plans, evidence requirements, and plan assurance records.
gaps: PlanAssurance still carries minimum AssuranceLevel ranks.
Not an execution or mutation permit.

compatibility_risk.rationale: Schema changes ripple across compiler/validator/admission.

fca_adaptation.rationale: Not a total assurance ladder; reuse or adapt under stated disposition.

components.semantic_authority: Snapshot-bound typed program dependency graph (call/data/state/schema/wiring); not proof authority.
gaps: Dynamic callees/factories marked incomplete.
Path heuristics can miss generated/native edges.

compatibility_risk.rationale: Large AST/index coupling for impact analysis.

fca_adaptation.rationale: Not a total assurance ladder; reuse or adapt under stated disposition.

components.semantic_authority: Verification-boundary semantic dependency graph; mandatory closure excludes untrusted/model annotations from authority-bearing sets.
gaps: Bounds (nodes/edges/depth) can truncate; truncated closures must not silently authorize.

compatibility_risk.rationale: Authority/trust enums are cross-cutting for SDI.

fca_adaptation.rationale: Not a total assurance ladder; reuse or adapt under stated disposition.

components.semantic_authority: Closed semantic-authority classification for dependency nodes used by mandatory closure.
gaps: Local graph authority, not portfolio authorization or proof promotion.

compatibility_risk.rationale: Small closed vocabulary; useful reference for FCA authority facet naming.

fca_adaptation.rationale: Not a total assurance ladder; reuse or adapt under stated disposition.

components.semantic_authority: Reference evaluator for principal/action/lease/fencing authorization decisions; never asserts generated-code correctness.
gaps: Datalog/SecPAL engines are shadow-only until fixture conformance.
Delegation depth is capped.

compatibility_risk.rationale: Security-sensitive policy schemas and engine adapters.

fca_adaptation.rationale: Not a total assurance ladder; reuse or adapt under stated disposition.

components.semantic_authority: Canonical grant contract for scoped capabilities including lease and fencing bindings.
gaps: GeneratedCodeCorrectness is permanently not_established by design.
Expired/revoked grants must remain fail-closed under FCA.

compatibility_risk.rationale: Grant schema is foundational for EAK authority admission.

fca_adaptation.rationale: Not a total assurance ladder; reuse or adapt under stated disposition.

components.semantic_authority: One-use mutation permit issuer after plan admission; verification consumes uses and never grants task-completion authority.
gaps: Requires current DecisionRequest + mandatory closure + fencing/lease bindings.

compatibility_risk.rationale: Replay/fencing bugs at this boundary are critical.

fca_adaptation.rationale: Not a total assurance ladder; reuse or adapt under stated disposition.

components.semantic_authority: Neutral Protocol for verified authority bindings; no key storage or I/O.
gaps: Implementation lives in control.profile_authority; ports alone are insufficient.

compatibility_risk.rationale: Thin Protocol surface.

fca_adaptation.rationale: Not a total assurance ladder; reuse or adapt under stated disposition.

components.semantic_authority: Proposal-only deterministic repair synthesizer under reviewed operators; no write/semantic/proof authority; hybrid residual path is separately named.
gaps: Does not import LLM surfaces; residual hybrid packets must not escalate authority.

compatibility_risk.rationale: Couples to CEGIS/doctor synthesizer contracts for RSE.

fca_adaptation.rationale: Not a total assurance ladder; reuse or adapt under stated disposition.

components.semantic_authority: Authoritative catalog of reviewed doctor repair operators/capabilities; unknown operators are rejected.
gaps: Registry contents are reviewed artifacts and must be version-pinned for FCA.

compatibility_risk.rationale: Closed enum/spec lookup surface.

fca_adaptation.rationale: Not a total assurance ladder; reuse or adapt under stated disposition.

components.semantic_authority: Drift-driven proof invalidation/reopen of affected evidence closures; cannot auto-weaken contracts or infer health from stale receipts.
gaps: Thin package; release-root policy path is environment-specific.

compatibility_risk.rationale: Couples to release evidence and invalidation closures.

fca_adaptation.rationale: Not a total assurance ladder; reuse or adapt under stated disposition.

components.semantic_authority: Authoritative fencing/lease coordination for daemon lanes; expired workers cannot publish after takeover.
gaps: DuckDB single-writer and file-lock assumptions.
Single-flight outcomes are not proof hits.

compatibility_risk.rationale: Concurrency/fencing correctness is hard to reimplement safely.

fca_adaptation.rationale: Not a total assurance ladder; reuse or adapt under stated disposition.

components.semantic_authority: Fail-closed signal when execution uses a superseded fencing token.
gaps: Error taxonomy is Profile-G coded; adapters must preserve fail-closed meaning.

compatibility_risk.rationale: Small error contract with clear semantics.

fca_adaptation.rationale: Not a total assurance ladder; reuse or adapt under stated disposition.

components.semantic_authority: Distributed single-flight coordinator for shared proof/work units; outcomes are coordination results, not proof authority.
gaps: Must not be misread as cache-hit semantic truth.

compatibility_risk.rationale: Deep coupling to lease store and proof cache single-flight.

fca_adaptation.rationale: Not a total assurance ladder; reuse or adapt under stated disposition.

components.semantic_authority: Checkout mutation lease/lock helper for merge trains and objective admission; not semantic proof authority.
gaps: POSIX/Windows lock backends differ; inactive-lease adoption needs liveness checks.

compatibility_risk.rationale: Filesystem/git common-dir coupling.

fca_adaptation.rationale: Not a total assurance ladder; reuse or adapt under stated disposition.

components.semantic_authority: Leased worker-lane execution under process fence; completion receipts are durable lane outcomes, not global proof.
gaps: Heavy DuckDB/task-identity coupling; process fencing edge cases.

compatibility_risk.rationale: Ops-specific lane runner; reuse patterns, not as FCA kernel.

fca_adaptation.rationale: Not a total assurance ladder; reuse or adapt under stated disposition.

components.semantic_authority: Checkpointed supervisor recovery dispositions/receipts under integrity bounds; detection is not unrestricted restart authority.
gaps: Programmatic recovery policies are bounded; fault-injection helpers must stay non-prod.

compatibility_risk.rationale: Checkpoint store formats and fault enums.

fca_adaptation.rationale: Not a total assurance ladder; reuse or adapt under stated disposition.

components.semantic_authority: Fail-closed execution of incident rescue proposals via multi-domain auth + one-use permits; no shell/provider surface.
gaps: Requires injected authorizers/permit boundary; planner proposals alone are non-authoritative.

compatibility_risk.rationale: Protocol-heavy; safe if adapters stay explicit.

fca_adaptation.rationale: Not a total assurance ladder; reuse or adapt under stated disposition.

components.semantic_authority: Finite-prefix counterexample detector for temporal properties; a clean prefix is no_violation_observed only and never proves unbounded properties.
gaps: Out-of-window/untimestamped events are inconclusive.
Reopen requests are observations, not auto-repair authority.

compatibility_risk.rationale: Event schema/lifecycle coupling for TEP monitors.

fca_adaptation.rationale: Not a total assurance ladder; reuse or adapt under stated disposition.

components.semantic_authority: Policy contract for which temporal properties a runtime monitor evaluates and how inconclusive traces are treated.
gaps: Policy alone does not observe effects.

compatibility_risk.rationale: Small policy DTO.

fca_adaptation.rationale: Not a total assurance ladder; reuse or adapt under stated disposition.

components.semantic_authority: Contracts for RUNNING stall classification and recovery-policy receipts; detection never grants restart or self-guardian attestation.
gaps: Client sessions never own monitor liveness; guardian adoption is separate.

compatibility_risk.rationale: Contract/DTO oriented.

fca_adaptation.rationale: Not a total assurance ladder; reuse or adapt under stated disposition.

acceptance_notes: Every reusable component records exact commit/path/symbol, semantic authority, gaps, adoption disposition, and compatibility risk.
Total assurance ladders (AssuranceLevel variants, ProofStatus rank usage, BackendSupportTier as support ladder) are flagged for conservative FCA adaptation rather than duplication.
Discovery in this report is not completion of FCA, migration, or proof.
